assets.name: Traveler's Loft
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production background wallpaper for Pocket Quests' customizable trophy ROOM, called Traveler's Loft. Input1 is the fantasy mobile app illustration style reference only; input2 is the matching painted traveler style reference only. Output ONLY a finished cozy room interior, no people/avatars, NO text, logos, UI, collectibles, trophies, books/trinkets or items on display surfaces. Full opaque rectangular canvas1312x1200, approximately square, detailed appealing hand-painted fantasy game illustration, crisp soft brush texture, warm neutral timber and cream plaster, restrained lavender-blue accents. A small comfortable loft, viewed mostly front-on with gentle three-quarter room depth, open uncluttered floor through the CENTER35–65% for an avatar standing at x50%,y93%. Keep all central space unobstructed. Build four EMPTY collectible display places with clear horizontal surfaces: upper-left back-wall shelf centered x25%,y37%, upper-right back-wall shelf centered x76%,y37%; low-left small display table centered x23%, table surface y70%; matching low-right display table centered x77%, table surface y70%. Each shelf/table is about20%canvas width, decorative simple carved warm wood, EMPTY and clearly readable. The pair of upper wall shelves has top standing surfaces at EXACTLY37%height; the low table standing surfaces at EXACTLY70%height. Shelves on back wall, short tables on floor near sides; no center furniture. Soft small rug bottom center, broad flat warm wooden floor foreground suitable for full-body avatar; no step/platform in center. Side windows at far-left and far-right bring soft daylight, glimpses of floating islands/clouds outside. Slight cozy beams at ceiling edges, crafted furniture and appealing fantasy detail, NO giant plants, no clutter, no chairs blocking floor, no floor objects. Keep display surfaces free for separately rendered earned decorations. Composition and furniture anchors will be reused exactly for other room styles, so prioritize clear symmetrical anchor placement, an appealing game location and central avatar staging. Color and detail should fit the referenced Pocket Quests painted floating-island world, not photorealistic architecture. No transparency or feathered white vignette: full room art to every edge.

assets.name: Sunlit Workshop
assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit. Edit this exact Pocket Quests Traveler's Loft room background into a SUNLIT WORKSHOP visual theme. Preserve the SAME canvas1312x1200, exact camera/perspective, wall/floor/window boundaries, all furniture positions and sizes and exact four empty display surfaces, center open floor, rug location, roof beam positions. Do not move or add/remove furniture. This is a different room color/material style on the SAME registered layout so app decoration overlays remain aligned. Make honey-colored oak timbers, softly pale warm stone/plaster walls, clear blue daylight from the same windows and outside floating islands, subtle warm golden morning sun, restrained blue and honey accents. Recolor the existing draped banner and rug accents from lavender to soft slate/sky blue with fine golden trim while retaining same shapes and simple mountain motifs. Cozy handcrafted fantasy game workshop atmosphere, detailed inviting painterly illustration matching source, no photorealism. ALL shelves and low tables MUST REMAIN EMPTY; no tools, books, props, clutter, trophies, plants, people, text or UI. Center35–65% stays unobstructed for an avatar. Full opaque artwork to edges, no transparency, no vignette. Do not zoom/crop or change perspective. This is only palette/material/light variation; preserve every geometric anchor.
